map.name: Hot Potato
map.objective: Throw hot potatoes at other teams to score points. Holding drains your score.

rules.rule: Tag an enemy: +120 (they get -100). Hit a teammate: -10.
Every potato you hold costs your team 1 point per second.
Highest score when time runs out wins.
